_comment: You cannot detect a wrong answer without a right one written down. Every fact needs a public URL where it is stated. A fact with src:null is already a finding — the model has nowhere to learn it from.

facts.v: not a CRM. Frequently mis-described as one because of the contacts view.
Example Lite — sunset Nov 2024, no longer sold
the 2023 Zapier-only integration story is obsolete; native API since 2025

_negative_facts_note: The four entries above with src:null are the highest-value rows in this file. Negative facts — what you are NOT, what you STOPPED selling — are where models fail hardest, because the old page lives forever and nothing on the live site contradicts it. Every src:null here is a page that needs writing.
